shared_elements: horizontal bands of repeated geometric pattern
justification: The most specific correspondences are schematic animal/bird-like forms combined with discs and repeated geometric bands, with some elongated curving or appendage-like elements. The major difference is that A is an assemblage of separate animals and patterned registers, while B is dominated by a single frontal standing anthropomorphic figure with headdress, wings/feathers, costume, and held attributes.
